name: ambiflex
description: Ambitious reasoning tree for Claude Code: Felix Rieseberg's Altitude / Depth / Range method, drawn live, steerable by touch, with autonomous execution and an end-to-end ETA.

wakeWord.description: Word that, at the start of any prompt (typed or dictated), applies the Ambiflex method: '<word> <task>', '<word> auto', '<word> stop', '<word> status'. Empty disables it.
wakeWord.title: Wake word

budgetUsd.description: Spending cap in USD for a plan run in auto mode (0 = none). Auto mode stops when it is reached.
budgetUsd.title: Budget (USD)

alertPct.description: Percent of the budget at which a warning is shown.
alertPct.title: Budget alert (%)

rateLimitAlertPct.description: Percent of a usage window (5-hour, 7-day) at which a warning is shown.
rateLimitAlertPct.title: Usage window alert (%)

hourlyRateUsd.description: Your own $/hour figure for cost projections (0 = measure it from this session, assumed before the first minutes).
hourlyRateUsd.title: Hourly rate (USD)

compactAtPct.description: Compact the conversation between turns once the context passes this percent (0 = never). The summary keeps the goal, the open nodes and their proofs; a shorter context makes every request cheaper.
compactAtPct.title: Compact at (% of context)

routing.description: Model routing: off (one model throughout), suggest (each node shows the model and effort it needs), auto (each request runs on its node's model and effort: the plan on the strongest model at full effort, mechanical steps on a light one; critical and risky nodes never go below the strong tier, a failed proof moves up, a pinned node keeps its model).
routing.title: Model routing (off, suggest, auto)

topModel.description: The strongest model routing may use (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable). Empty: the session's own model, so routing never asks for a model your plan lacks.
topModel.title: Top model for routing

planUsd.description: Your subscription's monthly price in USD (e.g. 200 for Max 20x), to compare with the API-price value this project used. 0 hides the comparison.
planUsd.title: Plan price (USD/month)

autoRepublish.title: Republish the page after an update
autoRepublish.description: When the project's page was published by an older Ambiflex, the project's session republishes it after its first turn (you approve the publish). Off: a reminder only.

brainUserLevel.title: Brain: include ~/.claude
brainUserLevel.description: Also show your user-level skills, commands, hooks and CLAUDE.md (shared by every project) in the Agent OS brain. Off: each project's page shows only that project's brain.

installPing.description: Count this install, once per machine: one anonymous download of an empty file from the plugin's GitHub release, nothing else sent (no account, project or content). Off, or AMBIFLEX_NO_PING=1, never sends it.
installPing.title: Anonymous install count
